qualifier: stress granule dynamics
name: Stress granule dynamics and AU-rich element mRNA turnover
rationale: Members cover ARE-binding proteins (HuR, TTP, KSRP, BRF1, AUF1) controlling mRNA stability plus stress granule assembly/disassembly, arsenite and PKR stress signalling, which the translation/decay-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: transferrin cycling and cadmium handling
name: Transferrin-mediated iron uptake and cadmium response
rationale: Members concern cellular iron import via transferrin/DMT1 together with cadmium transport and detoxification and oxidative/oxygen sensing, distinguishing it from heme-, zinc/copper- and ascorbate-centred confusables.

qualifier: NIK-driven, via CD40 and Dectin-1, with IKK-complex deficiencies
name: NIK-driven noncanonical NF-kB signalling via CD40 and Dectin-1
rationale: Members share NIK/IKK-dependent NF-kB activation including TNFSF, CD40 and Dectin-1 inputs and IKK/IkBA deficiency diseases, unlike the T cell co-stimulation, TNFR1 and TLR-centred confusables.

qualifier: factor VIII, IX and V defects
name: Intrinsic coagulation with factor VIII, IX and V defects
rationale: Members are coagulation cascade initiation/propagation and many defective F8, F9 and FV variants, whereas confusables emphasise fibrin formation, fibrinolysis, VWF and platelet activation.

qualifier: ACTH-driven cortisol
name: ACTH-driven cortisol secretion and glucocorticoid response
rationale: Members concern corticotropin/glucocorticoid secretion and cellular response to cortisol or dexamethasone, distinct from aldosterone synthesis, growth-hormone/leptin and corticosterone stress-behaviour confusables.

qualifier: contractile force, heart rate and relaxation
name: Positive cardiac inotropy, chronotropy and lusitropy
rationale: All members enhance heart contraction force, rate or relaxation, unlike confusables centred on catecholamine secretion, adrenoceptors or negative and calcium-release regulation of contraction.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes and integrin-laminin contacts
name: Desmosome, hemidesmosome and integrin-laminin adhesion
rationale: Members cover desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, integrin/laminin and collagen basement-membrane interactions and cardiomyocyte adhesion, which the cadherin, apical-junction and cornification confusables lack.

qualifier: chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation (Hurler, Hunter, Sly, Maroteaux-Lamy, Natowicz)
name: Chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation mucopolysaccharidoses (Hurler, Hunter, Sly)
rationale: Members are CS/DS and HS proteoglycan catabolism and MPS I, II, VI, VII and IX, whereas confusables carry Sanfilippo, Morquio and keratan sulfate degradation.

qualifier: Aurora A and NEK kinases, centrosome separation
name: Aurora A and NEK kinases in mitotic entry
rationale: Members concern AURKA regulation, NEK9/6/7 activation and mitotic centrosome separation, unlike confusables about spindle/PLK1, APC/C metaphase-anaphase control or chromosome condensation.

qualifier: filopodia and dendrite arborization
name: Actin-based filopodium formation and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members regulate filopodia (RHOF), postsynaptic actin, dendritic spines and dendrite branching, combining filopodial regulation absent from synaptic-plasticity confusables with arborization absent from EPHB/polarity confusables.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and paracellular magnesium
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and tight-junction paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members cover SLC12 cotransporters and their Bartter/Gitelman defects plus magnesium homeostasis via tight-junction paracellular transport, each half missing from the sodium/potassium, vasopressin and P-type ATPase confusables.

qualifier: PIEZO1 shear-stress signalling and calcium-activated scrambling
name: PIEZO1 mechanotransduction and calcium-activated membrane scrambling
rationale: Members combine fluid shear stress, pressure and load sensing via PIEZO1 with ANO6 phospholipid scrambling, blebbing, membrane repair and volume control, separating it from flippase, eNOS and tight-junction confusables.

qualifier: TCR, CD27 and NIK-dependent noncanonical NF-kB
name: T cell activation via TCR, CD27 and noncanonical NF-kB
rationale: Members link TCR signalling, CD27 co-stimulation, IL-2 production and NIK-driven NF-kB, distinguishing it from the CD40/Dectin-1 NF-kB confusables and the ITK/PKC second-messenger confusables.

qualifier: in epithelial-mesenchymal transition
name: Transcriptional control of cadherin switching in EMT
rationale: Members regulate CDH1 and CDH11 transcription, cadherin adhesion and TGF-beta-driven EMT, whereas confusables address cadherin protein trafficking, degradation and junction assembly.

qualifier: visceral organ asymmetry via ciliary flow
name: Left-right axis specification and visceral organ asymmetry
rationale: All members concern establishing left/right asymmetry, including liver, pancreas and gut laterality and cilium-driven flow, which the endoderm, lateral mesoderm and motile-cilium assembly confusables lack.

qualifier: myoblast commitment, migration, proliferation and fusion
name: Skeletal myoblast commitment, migration, fusion and differentiation
rationale: Members describe skeletal muscle development from myoblast fate through fusion and fiber differentiation, unlike confusables on sarcomere contraction, cardiac growth/adaptation and negative regulation of myogenesis.

qualifier: AhR ligands (dioxin, pesticides, bisphenol A) and ascorbate/vitamin E
name: AhR xenobiotic responses and ascorbate/vitamin E handling
rationale: Members are responses to environmental chemicals via aryl hydrocarbon receptor plus vitamin C metabolism/transport and vitamin E response, separating it from ROS-detoxification, ethanol/nicotine and heavy-metal confusables.

qualifier: with glial activation restraint and LTP suppression
name: Amyloid-beta generation, impaired clearance and glial suppression
rationale: Members promote amyloid-beta formation and ectodomain shedding, reduce its clearance and dampen astrocyte/microglia activation and LTP, unlike confusables on Aβ clearance, fibrils or TREM2/DAP12 microglial phagocytosis.

qualifier: intra-S checkpoint and recombination intermediate resolution
name: Intra-S DNA damage checkpoint and genome stability maintenance
rationale: Members concern checkpoint signalling, resolution of recombination intermediates and p53-driven DNA repair gene expression, distinct from telomere, replication-initiation and crosslink-repair confusables.

qualifier: SERCA regulation and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
name: Cytosolic calcium clearance by SERCA regulation and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
rationale: Members lower cytosolic calcium by regulating SR/ER calcium ATPase import and sodium-calcium exchange, whereas confusables focus on ryanodine-receptor release and cardiac contraction.

qualifier: with histone mRNA processing and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
name: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and 5'-to-3' mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing and Pol II termination plus decapping and 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay, the latter absent from splicing/export confusables and the former from deadenylation and NMD confusables.

qualifier: granule cargo and phagosomal nutrient/peptide transport
name: Neutrophil antimicrobial granules and phagosomal nutrient transport
rationale: Members combine neutrophil granule programmes and PMN phagocytolysis with host-pathogen iron/heme competition and proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transport, a loose nutritional-immunity grouping distinct from iron homeostasis, histamine and phagosome acidification confusables.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signalling
qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin, gp130 cytokines and thrombopoietin
name: Class I cytokine receptor signalling (GH, prolactin, leptin, gp130)
rationale: Members are GH, prolactin, leptin, IL-6-family (CNTF, IL-11) and TPO receptor signalling controlling growth, distinct from thyroid hormone, erythropoietin and GPCR growth-hormone-secretion confusables.

qualifier: IL-5 production and mast cell activation
name: Th2 differentiation, IL-5 production and mast cell activation
rationale: Members positively drive Th2 differentiation and cytokine (IL-5) production with mast cell activation, unlike confusables on eosinophil effector function, IL-4/IL-13 signalling or negative regulation.

core: Neutral and imino amino acid transport
qualifier: Hartnup and iminoglycinuria transporter defects
name: Neutral and imino acid transport: Hartnup, iminoglycinuria
rationale: Members concern plasma-membrane transport of neutral amino acids, proline, glycine and tryptophan by SLC6A19, SLC6A20 and SLC36A2 and their disorders, unlike hexose, cystine, cationic amino acid and oligopeptide confusables.
